comment: Golden vectors for firmware-telemetry/v2 Device Mode and Controller Profiles. Each case is a signed capability manifest message whose manifest is otherwise valid under v1. A consumer of this version must accept every case in 'cases' and refuse every case in 'reject_cases' with the declared reason. Each case is judged on its own against verifier_context, as the first manifest registered for that provisioning anchor. Signed with a disclosed TEST-ONLY seed, the same one the fault corpus discloses: never provision it.

reasons.invalid_device_mode: device_mode is not one of the four values, including a value of another JSON type, or is not the value the manifest's channels and actions determine
reasons.controller_profile_missing: a bridged channel carries no controller_profile
reasons.controller_profile_unexpected: a channel that is not bridged carries controller_profile
reasons.invalid_controller_profile: a controller_profile breaks its grammar, or a bridged channel's protocol is not modbus_rtu
reasons.invalid_alarm_channel: controller_alarm_word or bitmask on a channel that is not a bridged alarm word

cases.name: sensor_node
cases.note: one metering channel and no action

cases.name: sensor_node_two_sources
cases.note: every channel whose source is not foreign_device meters, whatever its source or protocol

cases.name: bridge_node
cases.note: one bridged channel and no action

cases.name: mixed_metering_bridged
cases.note: metering and bridged channels, no action

cases.name: mixed_metering_action
cases.note: an actuator that declares the channel its interlock reads is mixed

cases.name: mixed_bridged_action
cases.note: a bridged channel and an action

cases.name: mixed_all_three
cases.note: all three roles; the bridged channel comes first, so no position decides the mode

cases.name: bridge_node_qualified
cases.note: a bridged channel whose profile the device attests qualified, naming its record

cases.name: bridge_node_alarm_word
cases.note: an alarm-word channel reads the profile's alarm word as a bitmask

cases.name: bridge_node_one_profile_three_channels
cases.note: three channels read three channels of one profile, under one digest

cases.name: mixed_metering_and_alarm_word
cases.note: an alarm-word channel is bridged, so with a metering channel the device is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_unknown_string
reject_cases.note: a string outside the four values, over arrays that make the device a sensor_node

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_wrong_case
reject_cases.note: values compare exactly; a case variant of sensor_node is no value

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_integer
reject_cases.note: device_mode is a JSON string; an integer is another type

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_null
reject_cases.note: null is present but names no mode

reject_cases.name: reject_mode_boolean
reject_cases.note: device_mode is a JSON string; a boolean is another type

reject_cases.name: reject_sensor_node_with_action
reject_cases.note: a metering device that declares an action is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_sensor_node_with_bridged_channel
reject_cases.note: a channel whose source is foreign_device is bridged, so the arrays make this a bridge_node

reject_cases.name: reject_bridge_node_with_metering_channel
reject_cases.note: a bridge that also meters is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_mixed_single_role
reject_cases.note: mixed needs more than one role; metering alone is a sensor_node

reject_cases.name: reject_actuator_node_over_mixed
reject_cases.note: an actuator that declares a channel is mixed

reject_cases.name: reject_actuator_node_no_channels
reject_cases.note: the mode agrees with the arrays, so the empty channels alone refuse it; actuator_node is never accepted under this version

reject_cases.name: reject_bridged_without_profile
reject_cases.note: a bridged channel that names no profile; this was a valid v1 bridged channel

reject_cases.name: reject_alarm_word_without_profile
reject_cases.note: an alarm word with no profile could not be interpreted at all

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_on_metering_channel
reject_cases.note: a metering channel decodes through no controller profile

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_id_bad_character
reject_cases.note: a space is outside the fleet alphabet

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_id_too_long
reject_cases.note: an id is at most 48 characters

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_id_empty
reject_cases.note: an id is at least one character

reject_cases.name: reject_digest_uppercase
reject_cases.note: the digest is lowercase hex

reject_cases.name: reject_digest_no_prefix
reject_cases.note: the digest carries its sha256: prefix

reject_cases.name: reject_digest_long
reject_cases.note: sixty-five hex digits are not a SHA-256

reject_cases.name: reject_digest_short
reject_cases.note: sixty-three hex digits are not a SHA-256

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_channel_bad_character
reject_cases.note: a slash is outside the fleet alphabet

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_id_not_string
reject_cases.note: an id is a string

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_channel_empty
reject_cases.note: a fleet identifier is at least one character

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_channel_too_long
reject_cases.note: a fleet identifier is at most 48 characters

reject_cases.name: reject_digest_not_string
reject_cases.note: a digest is a string

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_channel_not_string
reject_cases.note: a profile channel is a string

reject_cases.name: reject_qualification_boolean
reject_cases.note: qualification is a string

reject_cases.name: reject_record_not_string
reject_cases.note: a record is a string or null

reject_cases.name: reject_record_dots_inside_segment
reject_cases.note: a record never contains ..

reject_cases.name: reject_qualification_unknown
reject_cases.note: qualified or unqualified only

reject_cases.name: reject_qualified_without_record
reject_cases.note: a qualified profile names its record

reject_cases.name: reject_unqualified_with_record
reject_cases.note: a record on an unqualified profile would read as a qualification

reject_cases.name: reject_record_absolute
reject_cases.note: a record does not begin with a slash

reject_cases.name: reject_record_parent
reject_cases.note: a record contains no ..

reject_cases.name: reject_record_empty_segment
reject_cases.note: a record has no empty segment

reject_cases.name: reject_record_trailing_slash
reject_cases.note: a record has no trailing slash

reject_cases.name: reject_record_empty
reject_cases.note: a record is at least one character

reject_cases.name: reject_record_too_long
reject_cases.note: a record is at most 127 characters

reject_cases.name: reject_record_bad_character
reject_cases.note: a space is outside the record alphabet

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_extra_key
reject_cases.note: the object's keys are exactly five; a site's bus address is not one

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_missing_record_key
reject_cases.note: record is present, as null, on an unqualified profile

reject_cases.name: reject_profile_not_object
reject_cases.note: controller_profile is an object, not a bare digest

reject_cases.name: reject_one_profile_two_qualifications
reject_cases.note: two channels name one profile id, one qualified and one not; a device holds one qualification per profile

reject_cases.name: reject_one_profile_two_digests
reject_cases.note: two channels name one profile id under two digests

reject_cases.name: reject_one_profile_two_records
reject_cases.note: two channels name one qualified profile under one digest with two records

reject_cases.name: reject_one_digest_two_ids
reject_cases.note: one digest named under two profile ids

reject_cases.name: reject_bridged_other_protocol
reject_cases.note: a controller profile describes Modbus RTU registers; a bridged channel on another protocol has no profile that could decode it

reject_cases.name: reject_alarm_word_type_on_metering
reject_cases.note: an alarm word is read from a foreign controller, so only a bridged channel may be one

reject_cases.name: reject_bitmask_unit_on_metering
reject_cases.note: the unit alone, on a metering channel

reject_cases.name: reject_alarm_word_type_on_metering_alone
reject_cases.note: the sensor type alone, on a metering channel

reject_cases.name: reject_alarm_word_type_wrong_unit
reject_cases.note: an alarm word's unit is bitmask

reject_cases.name: reject_bitmask_unit_on_measurement
reject_cases.note: bitmask is the unit of an alarm word only
